title: US criticism of China in Yellow Sea exposes strategic divide with Seoul: expert
caption:
A recent trilateral meeting in Atlanta highlighted a growing strategic divide between the US and South Korea. While the US is pushing to counter China's influence in the Yellow Sea, Seoul is prioritizing North Korean deterrence and diplomatic ties with Beijing.

Source: Koreaherald - US criticism of China in Yellow Sea exposes strategic divide with Seoul: expert
